title: A Trip to the Market
text: At the market, I saw a huge watermelon and a tiny apple. My mom picked a medium basket, but it was too small for everything. The road to the market is wide, but the little path behind our house is narrow. When we got home, half of the fruit filled one bowl, so we needed another bowl too. Now our fridge is full, but the basket at the market looked empty!
